sections.heading: Encryption at rest and in transit
sections.text: All customer data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.3. Encryption keys are rotated every 90 days and managed in a dedicated hardware-backed key service.

sections.heading: Authentication and access control
sections.text: Access to production systems requires single sign-on with multi-factor authentication and role-based access control. Privileged access is reviewed quarterly and all access is logged to the central audit log.

sections.heading: Incident response and breach notification
sections.text: Helios Home maintains a documented incident response plan that is tested twice each year. Customers are notified within 72 hours of a confirmed breach affecting their data.

sections.heading: Backups and retention
sections.text: Backups are taken daily and retained for 35 days. Restore tests are performed monthly. Backups are encrypted and stored in a separate region from production data.

sections.heading: Penetration testing
sections.text: Helios Home engages an independent firm for annual penetration testing of the customer portal and installer platform, alongside continuous vulnerability scanning. Critical findings are remediated within 30 days.

sections.heading: Patch management
sections.text: Security patches for critical vulnerabilities are applied within 7 days of release and high severity patches within 30 days. Servers are scanned weekly for missing patches.

sections.heading: Uptime and service levels
sections.text: Helios Home guarantees 99.9 percent monthly uptime for the customer portal and installer platform, excluding scheduled maintenance, with service credits when the target is missed.

sections.heading: Onboarding timeline
sections.text: Standard onboarding takes 2 to 3 weeks and includes data migration, installer training and a dedicated onboarding manager for the first 30 days.

sections.heading: Data residency and hosting
sections.text: Customer data is hosted in the United States in the us-east-1 and us-west-2 cloud regions. Customer data does not leave the United States without written customer consent.

sections.heading: Support hours
sections.text: Support is available around the clock for critical incidents, with a one hour response target, and during business hours for standard requests.

sections.heading: Data processing and subprocessors
sections.text: Helios Home offers a Data Processing Agreement on request and maintains a public list of subprocessors. The subprocessor list is updated at least 30 days before any new subprocessor processes customer data.

sections.heading: Certifications and audits
sections.text: Helios Home is audited annually against the SOC 2 Type II criteria covering security, availability and confidentiality.
